source_verification.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('research/evidence/runs/2026-11-17-next-document-candidates-01')
entries=json.loads((base/'sources.json').read_text())['sources']
records=[]
for entry in entries:
    data=Path(entry['path']).read_bytes()
    records.append({'id':entry['id'],'hash_matches':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==entry['sha256']})
firmroot=Path('research/evidence/runs/2026-11-11-firmware-boundary-01')
firm=json.loads((firmroot/'report.json').read_text())['snapshots']['before']['files']
bpfroot=Path('research/evidence/runs/2026-11-05-bpf-history-01')
bpf=json.loads((bpfroot/'manifest.json').read_text())['files']
expected={str(firmroot/'before'/item['path']):item['sha256'] for item in firm}
expected.update({str(bpfroot/item['path']):item['sha256'] for item in bpf})
cfroot=Path('research/evidence/runs/2026-11-12-cfg-membership-01')
expected.update({str(cfroot/path):digest for path,digest in json.loads((cfroot/'report.json').read_text())['artifact_sha256'].items()})
bcroot=Path('research/evidence/runs/2026-11-05-bpf-conformance-01')
bcreport=json.loads((bcroot/'report.json').read_text())['source_sha256']
for original in bcreport:
    expected[str(bcroot/Path(original).name)]=bcreport[original]
prior=[{'id':entry['id'],'matches_prior_record':entry['sha256']==expected[entry['path']]} for entry in entries if entry['path'] in expected]
old_dtb=firmroot/'before/drivers/firmware/rs-fdtree/src/fwnode_backend/dtb.rs'
same_dtb=Path(next(item['path'] for item in entries if item['id']=='F3'))
print(json.dumps({'source_checks':records,'prior_record_checks':prior,'F3_equals_archived_before_dtb':old_dtb.read_bytes()==same_dtb.read_bytes(),'experiments_run':0,'models_dispatched':0,'network_requests':0},ensure_ascii=False))
assert all(item['hash_matches'] for item in records)
assert all(item['matches_prior_record'] for item in prior)
assert old_dtb.read_bytes()==same_dtb.read_bytes()
PY
